notes.title: Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey 

Couple weeks ago I updated the game to increase the difficulty level slightly and some bug fixes.
Today I once more increased the difficulty level on all levels upon request. I also changed weapon and enemy stats. 

If you have any feedback or problems feel free to post in the community hub and I'll have a look into it.


Regards
Nifty Productions
